title: Direct execution work scaling with retained relevant subset
question: Can an indexed runtime preserve the exact aggregate capability while changing actual execution work from O(H) candidate programs to O(R) candidate programs with R fixed?
hypothesis: H_exec_subset: with a fixed relevant set R=4, exact content addressing can preserve task capability while exhaustive execution work grows with H and selective execution work remains bounded by R.

arms.name: exhaustive
arms.intervention: execute every candidate in the static universe

arms.name: selective
arms.intervention: exact content-address index then execute only retained relevant candidates

endpoints.name: success_rate
endpoints.role: primary — exact aggregate output matches hidden environment truth

endpoints.name: executor_candidates_per_query
endpoints.role: secondary — actual number of candidate programs executed

endpoints.name: address_query_positions
endpoints.role: secondary — marked positions inspected per query

endpoints.name: amortized_index_build_candidates
endpoints.role: secondary — one-time build amortized across queries

decision_rule.condition: selective success_rate equals exhaustive success_rate at every registered H and selective executor_work_per_query equals 4*9 while exhaustive equals H*9
decision_rule.licenses: bounded support for the execution-side selective-computation boundary: actual execution work depends on retained R rather than H in the registered synthetic workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: semantic learned retrieval, long-horizon memory, hardware FLOP superiority, or the full L4 C5 claim

decision_rule.condition: selective success_rate is materially below exhaustive at any H
decision_rule.licenses: the registered selective execution boundary does not preserve capability under this task

held_constant: candidate universe is fixed per seed and H and reused for all 100 queries
exactly four relevant candidates exist for every query at every H
the same exact executor is used in exhaustive and selective arms
the selective index is built once per static population
query relation uses six public marked positions; hidden truth is only used by the independent evaluator
each candidate execution carries exactly 9 registered work units
K=4 is fixed before the run
no learning, repair, or outcome feedback is used
